definitions.explanation: A skin injury caused by prolonged pressure on the body, typically occurring in people who are bedridden or unable to change position. A common concern in nursing care.

examples.english: Bedsores developed from a long hospital stay.

notes: Composed of {床|とこ} (bed) + ⟦ずれ→ずれ：10044_zure⟧ (slipping, rubbing — from ⟦ずれる→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧). The formal medical term is {褥瘡|じょくそう} (decubitus ulcer). Common collocations: {床|とこ}ずれ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ (to prevent bedsores), {床|とこ}ずれ⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧ (bedsore prevention), {床|とこ}ずれ⟦{防止|ぼうし}→防止：14571_boushi⟧⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧ (pressure relief mat). An important concept in ⟦{介護|かいご}→介護：04805_kaigo⟧ (caregiving) — turning bedridden patients every two hours is standard practice. In Japan's aging society, {床|とこ}ずれ prevention is a key component of both hospital and home care.
